user.title: Comfort Band setup
user.description: Add a zone or set up the profile manager (only one is needed).

zone.title: Add a zone
zone.description: Each zone watches one room-temperature sensor and (when enabled) drives one climate entity. The slug becomes part of every entity_id, so use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only.

profile_manager.title: Set up profile manager
profile_manager.description: Creates the global active-profile selector with built-in profiles (home, away, sleep). Only one is allowed.

abort.already_configured: A zone with this name already exists.
abort.single_instance_allowed: A profile manager is already configured.

error.invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only (2-32 characters; must start with a letter).
